title: 第二十二章   宇旅之术
content_zh:
踏白的到来，对四时剑来说，可以说是解了燃眉之急。

    这四个羽人虽然不是他的对手，但他也不可能快速，从羽人的纠缠中脱身，继续追厌火。

    “你们快去追厌火。”四时剑手指向厌火离开的方向。

    踏白所属的背嵬军，是夏的直属军队“梓桑八旅”。

    当年夏为了解决，黄土古族的兵员不足和诸侯坐大的问题，秉着“土人守土”的原则，以生死境为标准，将本地生死境以上士人抽出，成立了梓桑八旅。

    提拔顶尖的寒士，封为男爵，用来领导梓桑八旅。

    虽只是五爵里地位最低的男爵，但也开启了寒士封爵的先河。在这之前，除了少数几个归化蛮夷被封为子爵，其他所有的爵位都是被黄土古族占据。

    寒士想封侯，绝无可能！

    踏白本来就是，背嵬军中的精锐斥候，人人轻甲快马，平时的主要任务就是侦查与追踪。

    他们平时对付的都是能飞行的羽人，现在去追厌火，当然是不在话下。

    “走。”领头的将领调转马头，带领队伍就准备朝四时剑手指的方向追去。

    看到踏白已经调转马头，其中一名羽人从怀中掏出一把种子，脱离了阵形，飞过到踏白上方，将种子洒下。

    其余三名羽人见状，马上补位变换成三角阵形，各自将一颗种子握在手中，口中念念有词，种子在手中飞速的成长，瞬息之间就长成一块盾牌形状。

    踏白头上的羽人也完成了他的操作，种子长成无数的带刺藤条，交织纵横，参差错落将踏白们围在中间。

    完成阻击踏白的任务后，羽人迅速归位，与其他三名羽人一起，继续与四时剑纠缠一起。

    剑宗与羽人厮杀多年，两边可以说是知根知底，这次羽人准备充分，所用阵法和武器，都死死地克制住了四时剑的力量。

    踏白与羽人对战经验丰富，对这种套路见怪不怪，抽出长刀，相互之间配合默契，高效快速地清理着藤条，加上人数众多，不大一会便砍出了一条路。

    看到踏白们离开，这次羽人不仅未加阻拦，还停止了对四时剑的纠缠。

    一道道光束，从云层中穿出，笼罩到羽人们的身上。

    “不好，想逃。”

    这是最后的机会，四时剑催动元气，全力以赴的一剑挥出。

    光束将他的攻击全都吸收，没有对羽人产生一丝伤害。

    光束中，羽人的身体变得越变越淡，若有若无，眼看就要完全消失。

    有些熟悉的威压出现在天地间，羽人们原本快消失的身体，一阵阵闪动变得越来越清晰。

    半透明的虚影出现在四时剑面前，一张圆圆的大脸，完全占据了他的视野，圆脸姑娘眯着眼睛，嘴角满是微笑：“是不是很刺激。”

    “你们也觉得很刺激吧？”圆脸姑娘对着羽人问道，笑容依旧甜蜜。

    “居然是宇旅之术！”献收起脸上的笑容，变得严肃起来，伸手摸向光柱，明亮的光柱在她的指尖瞬间变得暗淡。

    宇旅之术！

    这是绝对的禁术，只要被发现，绝对是追查到底，直到彻底毁灭，使用者甚至没有履行景晖之盟的机会。
content_en:
The arrival of Tabai can be said to have solved an urgent need for the Four Seasons Sword.

    Although these four feathered men were no match for him, it was impossible for him to escape from the entanglement of the feathered men quickly and continue to pursue Yanhuo.

    "Hurry up and chase after Yanhuo." Si Shi pointed his sword finger in the direction where Yanhuo left.

    The Beiwei Army to which Tabai belongs is the "Eight Zisang Brigade", an army directly under Xia.

    In the summer of that year, in order to solve the problem of the Loess Ancient Clan's shortage of soldiers and the power of the princes, adhering to the principle of "natives guarding the land" and using the realm of life and death as the standard, local scholars above the realm of life and death were drawn out to establish the Zisang Eighth Brigade.

    Promote the top humble soldiers and make them barons to lead the Zisang Eighth Brigade.

    Although he was only the lowest baron among the five nobles, he also set the precedent for Hanshi to be knighted. Prior to this, except for a few naturalized barbarians who were granted the title of viscount, all other titles were occupied by the ancient Loess tribe.

    It is absolutely impossible for a poor scholar to become a marquis!

    Tabai was originally an elite scout in the Beiwei army. He was equipped with light armor and fast horses. His main task in peacetime was reconnaissance and tracking.

    They usually deal with Yumen who can fly, but now they are going to chase Tienhuo. Of course, it is no problem.

    "Let's go." The leading general turned his horse's head and led the team to chase in the direction pointed by the Four Seasons Sword.

    Seeing that Tabai had turned his horse's head, one of the feathered men took out a handful of seeds from his arms, broke away from the formation, flew over Tabai, and sprinkled the seeds.

    Seeing this, the other three feathered men immediately took up their positions and transformed into a triangle formation. Each held a seed in their hands and muttered words. The seeds grew rapidly in their hands and grew into the shape of a shield in an instant.

    The feathered man on Tabai's head also completed his operation, and the seeds grew into countless thorny vines, intertwined vertically and horizontally, and surrounded the Tabais in the middle.

    After completing the task of blocking Tabai, Yu Ren quickly returned to his position and, together with the other three Yu Ren, continued to tangle with the Four Seasons Sword.

    The sword sect and Yuren have been fighting for many years, and both sides know each other well. This time Yuren was fully prepared, and the formations and weapons they used were all able to restrain the power of the Four Seasons Sword.

    Tabai had rich experience in fighting with Yuren, so he was not surprised by this routine. He drew his long knife and cooperated with each other to clear the vines efficiently and quickly. With the large number of people, he cut a path in a short time.

    Seeing the Tabais leaving, Yuren not only did not stop them this time, but also stopped entangled with the Four Seasons Sword.

    Beams of light penetrated from the clouds and enveloped the feathered people.

    "No, I want to escape."

    This was the last chance. The Four Seasons Sword activated his vitality and swung the sword with all his strength.

    The beam absorbed all his attacks without causing any harm to Yu Ren.

    In the beam of light, the Yuren's body became lighter and lighter, and if it appeared or disappeared, it was about to disappear completely.

    Some familiar coercion appeared between heaven and earth, and the feathered people's bodies that were about to disappear began to flash more and more clearly.

    A translucent shadow appeared in front of the Four Seasons Sword, and a big round face completely occupied his field of vision. The round-faced girl squinted her eyes and smiled: "Isn't it exciting?"

    "You also find it exciting, right?" The round-faced girl asked Yuren, her smile still sweet.

    "It's actually the art of space travel!" Xian put away the smile on her face, became serious, stretched out her hand to touch the light pillar, and the bright light pillar instantly dimmed at her fingertips.

    The art of space travel!

    This is an absolutely forbidden technique. As long as it is discovered, it will be traced to the end until it is completely destroyed. The user does not even have a chance to fulfill Jinghui's alliance.
title_en: Chapter 22: The Art of Space Travel
